# v0.0.13 — survives a runtime going bad: automatic WebView2 runtime failover
- When the WebView2 runtime in use stops hosting (blank page, init error 0x8007139F), the app now switches to the next installed runtime instead of retrying the dead one for five minutes. Order: last runtime that worked, a shipped `WebView2Runtime` folder next to the exe, the evergreen runtime, then the newest Edge Beta. Each gets two tries, about 3 seconds apart.
- The runtime that works is remembered (`FloatCore3.exe.WebView2\fc-last-good-runtime.txt`), so the next launch, popups and other windows start on it right away.
- `%TEMP%\fc-init.log` shows each candidate tried (`RUNTIME ... candidate=i/n`), skips, and which one worked (`RUNTIME OK`).
